name: media-squirrel
description: 本地媒体下载管理平台（微博/抖音 下载·订阅·媒体库）

scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n backend,vite,electron -c blue,green,yellow "python run.py --no-browser --no-tray" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run icon && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:build:dir: npm run icon && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win dir --x64
